theorem_rows.name: small_factor_loss_ladder_identity
theorem_rows.statement: For any threshold y, the y-small-factor loss is the number of residue-cap slots whose companion m has least prime factor <=y.

theorem_rows.name: finite_lpf43_loss_floor
theorem_rows.statement: On the current P>=2001 sweep, y=43 covers the required composite-loss floor for every selector row.

theorem_rows.name: finite_lpf7_single_exception
theorem_rows.statement: On the current P>=2001 sweep, y=7 fails only at the exact boundary row P=2467, minus, rho=7.

theorem_rows.name: global_small_factor_loss_floor
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof must derive an adaptive small-factor CRT loss floor, or route persistent large-prime companions to PDEC/SAE.

plain_conclusion: 本步把伴随合数损耗进一步分解为 least-prime-factor 小因子阶梯。当前 `P>=2001` 重放中，损耗余量为 0 的贴边行只有 1 个；`lpf(m)<=7` 只在 1 个高段行不足，而 `lpf(m)<=43` 的小因子损耗已覆盖全部行，失败数为 0。这说明当前有限障碍集中在小模 CRT 覆盖，而不是大素数尾项；但固定 43 不能当作全局定理，严格闭合仍需自足证明自适应小因子损耗下界，或排斥 large-prime companion persistence PDEC/SAE。

decision_rows.meaning: 伴随合数损耗已按 least-prime-factor 阶梯精确拆分。
有限重放中 lpf<=43 足以支付全部损耗下界；这不是全局证明。
lpf<=7 的唯一高段失败是贴边行 P=2467, minus, rho=7。
仍需从 CRT 小模覆盖/层叠筛推出全局小因子损耗下界。
本步只把合数损耗下界压成小因子阶梯。
